recommendation: Implement screening and resource connection for food insecurity
implementation_steps: Screen for food insecurity using validated tools like the two-item Hunger Vital Sign
Document results in electronic health records with clear follow-up pathways
Connect patients to appropriate food resources including federal nutrition programs
Follow up to ensure successful linkage to services
Coordinate with community-based organizations to address ongoing food needs
evidence_summary: Systematic screening and resource connection for food insecurity has demonstrated improvements in food security status, healthcare utilization, and health outcomes across multiple studies.
